patterns.note: Content sections frequently integrate large, custom illustrations that serve as background elements, often extending beyond the main text columns and creating a sense of depth and whimsy.
A sophisticated, high-contrast pairing of an elegant serif display font for primary headings and a clean, highly readable sans-serif for body text and subheadings.

A soft, muted primary palette of sky blues and off-whites provides a calm backdrop, punctuated by vibrant, naturalistic accent colors derived directly from the custom illustrations (e.g., warm yellows, soft greens, muted pinks).

A large, stylized brand mark (the 'baba' logo) is used as a background layer that gradually reveals and scrolls behind content sections, creating a layered depth effect as the user scrolls down the page.
Informational sections are often presented with a clear two-column layout, pairing a concise heading and description with a relevant, often custom-illustrated, visual or photograph.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport, using CSS keyframes. The hero background features a gentle parallax effect with illustrative elements moving slower than the foreground content. A large, stylized brand mark is positioned as a fixed or slow-scrolling background layer that reveals progressively as content scrolls over it, adding a unique brand presence to the page depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by clear, readable sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., buttons and cards have a slight, consistent corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding within content blocks, creating a light and open feel).

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extensive use of whimsical, hand-drawn illustrations that are deeply integrated into the layout and scroll experience. These illustrations, particularly the large, revealing brand mark and the parallax hero, elevate the design beyond a standard template, creating a unique and memorable visual identity that softens a potentially complex topic.
